evidence_snippets: Auto scaling - App Engine automatically scales your application based on incoming load.
Based on Compute Engine , the App Engine flexible environment automatically scales your app up and down while also balancing the load.
Critical, backwards compatible updates are automatically applied to the underlying operating system.
